requests.emptyHint: Requests for permission to publish show up here.
requests.ownRequest: This is your own request: someone else on the moderation team needs to review it.

approveDialog.title: Approve {handle}?
approveDialog.description: They'll be able to publish videos right away and will be notified.
approveDialog.label: Welcome message

rejectDialog.title: Reject {handle}'s request?
rejectDialog.description: The reason is sent to them, and they can ask again after a few minutes.
rejectDialog.label: Reason

actions.videoReview: put under review the video “{title}” by

restrict.title: Restrict {handle}
restrict.description: They're notified with the reason. The restriction ends on its own when it expires.
restrict.banPermanent: A ban is always permanent (it can be revoked later).
restrict.reasonHint: Shown to them and kept in the log.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke the {type} restriction?
revokeDialog.description: It stops applying now and stays in the history. They'll be notified.
revokeDialog.label: Reason for revoking

reasonDialog.noteHint: Shown to the author along with the reason.

reports.author: Author:
reports.ownCase: Report against your own content: someone else on the team needs to review it.
reports.underReviewDone: Video under review: it's offline until the decision.
reports.afterRestrict: Author restricted. Now remove the content or dismiss the report.
reports.emptyHint: Reports on videos and comments show up here, grouped by content.
reports.gone: The content was deleted by its author.

dismiss.title: Dismiss the reports?
dismiss.description: The content doesn't break the rules. If it was under review, it goes back online. Nobody is notified.
dismiss.label: Internal note

actioned.title: Mark as handled?
actioned.description: Use it when action was already taken (e.g. the author was restricted or deleted the content).
actioned.label: Internal note

remove.description: The author is notified with the reason. The video can be restored later; the comment can't.

review.description: The video goes offline while you investigate. The owner is notified. The case stays open.

reports.ownCaseAdmin: Your own content: as an admin you can decide. The decision is flagged in the log.

purgeComment.title: Delete the comment permanently?
purgeComment.description: The text is erased and can't be recovered (a copy stays in the log). The report is closed. For something reversible, use “Remove comment”.

purge.title: Delete the video permanently?
purge.description: Erases the video from the database and the video server, with likes and comments. There's no undo. For something reversible, use “Remove video”. The owner is notified; title, owner and reason stay in the log.

effects.comment: They won't be able to comment or reply.
effects.upload: They won't be able to upload videos (published ones stay online).
effects.react: They won't be able to like/dislike.
effects.ban: They can't sign in anymore; channel, videos and comments are hidden.

notice.react: You can't react to videos until {until}.
notice.suspend: Your account is suspended until {until}: for now you can only watch.

noticePermanent.upload: You can no longer publish videos.
noticePermanent.react: You can no longer react to videos.
noticePermanent.suspend: Your account is suspended: you can only watch.

visibility.label: Visibility

private.label: Private
private.hint: Only you can see it. Publish whenever you want.

public.label: Public
public.hint: Shows up for everyone once it's ready.

visibility.underReviewHint: This video is under review by the moderators and isn't visible to anyone for now.
visibility.removedHint: This video was removed by the moderators and isn't visible to anyone.
visibility.moderatedHint: Until the moderators release it, the video stays hidden even if it's public.
visibility.privateOwnerHint: This video is private: only you can see it.
visibility.privateStaffHint: Private video: you can see it because you're a moderator.
visibility.staffOnly: You can see it because you're a moderator.

report.description: Your report is anonymous: only the moderators see it. The author won't know who reported.
report.detailsHint: Help the moderators: what's wrong and where (e.g. at 2:10).
report.sent: Report sent. Thanks for helping keep the platform safe.

spam.label: Spam or scam
spam.hint: Repetitive ads, misleading links, requests for money.

harassment.label: Harassment or bullying
harassment.hint: Attacks, threats or humiliation of someone.

hate.label: Hate speech
hate.hint: Attacks based on race, religion, gender, orientation, origin…

violence.label: Violence
violence.hint: Real assault, glorifying violence or shocking content.

misleading.label: Misleading information
misleading.hint: False content that can cause harm.

copyright.label: Copyright
copyright.hint: Using someone else's content without permission.
